Ascent to Greatness: This model scores Critical Hits on a 5+. Once per Battle during your Command Phase, you can choose to improve this ability until the end of that Battle Round. When you do so, select 1 of the following to be in effect:

  • Every successful Hit is considered a Critical Hit
  • This model now scores Critical Wounds on a 4+

Join Me in Glory: Each Battle Round, during your Command Phase, select 1 Chaos Undivided Infantry unit with at least 1 model within 3" of this model. That unit gains the Bodyguard ability for this model when this model is the subject of an enemy attack until the end of the Battle Round. However, that unit must remain wholly within 6" of this model for the duration of the Battle Round in order for this ability to be in effect.

The Prize is Ours: While this model is wholly within range of a Primary Objective Marker in No Mans Land or the enemy's Deployment Zone:

  • It is considered to have an Objective Control Value of 20.
  • Friendly Chaos Undivided Battleline units with at least 1 model within 6" of this model gain the Fearless ability.

Prescience [Psychic]: This model can attempt to use this Psychic ability during your Command Phase. If the Psychic Test is passed, enemy models making attacks against this model (and the unit it is leading, if applicable) reduce their Hit rolls by 1 and their Initiative by 1 until the end of the Battle Round.

Gift of Chaos [Physic]: This model can attempt to use this Psychic ability as part of its Activation, when making an attack against an enemy unit within 9" of this model. If successful, it and the models in the unit it is leading (if applicable):

  • Increase their Strength characteristic by 1
  • Gain the Hazardous D3+1 ability

These effects last until the end of the Battle Round.

Warp Rift [Psychic]: This model can attempt to use this Psychic ability as part of its Activation, after completing a Move Action. If successful, this model (and the unit it is leading, if applicable) can immediately then complete 1 of the following options:

  • Increase their Movement characteristic to 12" and gain the Phase Shift ability.
  • Use the Ascend to the Skies Action. During the next Battle Round, this model (and the unit it is leading, if applicable) have the Deep Strike ability. However, if this model (and the unit it is leading, if applicable) do not Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves in that subsequent Battle Round, they are considered Destroyed.

Despoiler

Tyrant

clauses.prose: Combi-bolter

sections.prose:
Drop Pod Bay: Instead of using this model's standard Transport [X] capacity, players can choose to embark up to 1 Heretic Astartes Walker unit inside this model.

Drop Pod Assault: This model must begin the battle in Strategic Reserves. Further, this model and friendly Heretic Astartes units embarked in this model do not count towards the typical restrictions for the percentage of your army that can begin in Strategic Reserves. However, if your army includes more than 3 of this unit, a minimum of 1 of these units must Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves during the first and second Battle Rounds.

Vectored Descent: When this model arrives on the battlefield via strategic reserves using its Deep Strike ability, it does not follow the deployment limitations for that ability. Instead:

  • During Battle Rounds 1, this model can be deployed anywhere on the battlefield that does not contact a terrain feature and is not within 8" (horizontally or vertically) of any enemy models.
  • During Battle Rounds 2, this model can be deployed anywhere on the battlefield that does not contact a terrain feature and is not within 6" (horizontally or vertically) of any enemy models.
  • During Battle Round 3 onwards, this model can be deployed anywhere on the battlefield that does not contact a terrain feature and is not within 3" (horizontally or vertically) of any enemy models.
This model can replace its Combi-bolter with 1 Missile Launcher.
